limits: Tags are derived from source-category and known identity/cohort patterns, not a runtime trace or a verified visual defect.
A source triage flag can apply to a renderer path without any visible effect for a particular model, scene or state.
No original owner approval is changed by triage.
The ten extra source cases have no newly assigned original catalog numbers.
No case has a matching live Canvas and Pixi screenshot from this work.
